ns2:course.label: Writing with Video
ns2:course.description: Students will engage in structuring creative, analytic, and argumentative essays with video. They will adapt the basic, traditional principles of critical writing and analysis, to communicate effectively using image production and post-production. Furthermore, students will make use of alphabetical literacy to evaluate their own video essays and the media work of others. Prerequisite: Any Composition I course. Additional Facilities Fee of $75 Required.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Advanced Composition, Literature and the Arts, and Western Compartv Cult course.
